gui.guhs.droombadje.start: Plop! A bubble takes you along. Sneak = hop out.
gui.guhs.droombadje.uit: Plop! The bubble popped. Gently down, vads...
gui.guhs.droombadje.klaar: The bubble sets you down gently. Njeg, what a ride!
gui.guhs.droombadje.stop: Click the bath thing! (The bubble waits a moment.)
gui.guhs.droombadje.al: You already have that one, vads. On to the next cloud!
gui.guhs.droombadje.alle: All three bath things! Bring them to Snoes by the little bath.
gui.guhs.droombadje.snoes.nog: Snoes: 'A... bath? I've never had a bath. Without a duck and soap I don't dare...' (%s/3)
gui.guhs.droombadje.snoes.al: Snoes: 'I've never been this clean. I smell of bubbles! Njeg!'
gui.guhs.droombadje.stukje: A piece of Snoes' dream: clean and warm. (%s/5)
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.kijk: Is that... all for me? A duck, a soap and... foam?
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.teen: Just one toe first. Ooh. Warm!
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.blub: Blub blub blub... I'm a bubble!
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.dank: I've never had a bath before. Thank you, vadsje.
scene.guhs.droombadje_snoes_bad.vertelle: Snoes is clean and warm. A piece of his dream comes back.
